description.value:
Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon with which you have expert proficiency.

Your belief in freedom can even sever magic. Select a magical effect that has made an adjacent member of your crop clumsy, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Paralyzed], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained], or slowed. You attempt to counteract that effect using your attack modifier with the required weapon as your counteract modifier. Your counteract rank is half your level rounded up. On a failure, you can't attempt to use Cut the Bonds on that effect on that crop member for 24 hours.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
